_about: The scatter rules of the generated land (src/core/gen/scatter.js). props: the things that stand on the land, in this order (an earlier kind takes its cells first). prop: the kind (src/world/props/). spacing: no two of a kind are nearer than this (cells; Poisson-disk samples, never a grid). size: the footprint (cells). chance: the part of the samples that stay. patch: a noise that makes groves (scale in cells; a sample stays where the noise is over `over`, from -1 to 1). The rules of a cell (each a range [from, to]): level (the height digit), water (cells to the nearest water), road (cells to the nearest road), field (cells to the nearest paddy). on: the ground letters (see the legend of the maps). life: groups of living things (kind in data/world/life.json, n: from and to, r: the radius in cells), with the same rules. margin: cells from the edge of a map with nothing on them, so that the edges stay open.
